fxmacrodata.description: FXMacroData remote MCP: official central-bank and statistics-agency macro data for FX across 22 currencies (policy rates, CPI, GDP, employment, bond yields), release calendars, COT positioning, commodities and FX spot rates. Works without a key for USD releases (last 90 days, 15-minute delay), the USD release calendar, USD press releases and the USD data catalogue, up to 100 requests/day. For other currencies, FX rates and full history, add "headers": {"Authorization": "Bearer <YOUR_FXMACRODATA_API_KEY>"} (keys at https://fxmacrodata.com/subscribe).
